$comment: Settings contract: keys, types, defaults, labels, descriptions, and CSS-var bindings. Read by Rust (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/config.rs) via include_str! and by the frontend via a static import (lib/settings-schema.ts). Theme preset *values* are not part of the contract — they live in shared/themes/*.json, one file per preset. Per docs/consolidation.md: do not declare defaults, labels, or types anywhere else.

settings.label: Font Size
settings.description: Font size in pixels for the editor

settings.label: Zoom
settings.description: Editor text zoom in percent, on top of Font Size. Cmd+= and Cmd+- step through presets; Cmd+0 returns to 100.

settings.label: Line Height
settings.description: Line height multiplier for the editor

settings.label: Content Width
settings.description: Maximum width of the text column in pixels

settings.label: Properties Panel
settings.description: How a note's properties panel starts: Auto collapses blocks with more than 6 properties or 8 lines to one summary row, Collapsed always does, Expanded never does. Toggling a note's panel overrides this until the app quits.

settings.label: Tab Size
settings.description: Number of spaces per tab

settings.label: Words
settings.description: Show the word count in the status bar

settings.label: Characters
settings.description: Show the character count in the status bar

settings.label: Paragraphs
settings.description: Show the paragraph count in the status bar

settings.label: Schema
settings.description: Light or dark color schema

settings.label: Sidebar Width
settings.description: Default sidebar width in pixels

settings.label: Sidebar Visible
settings.description: Show the sidebar by default

settings.label: Sidebar Sort
settings.description: Order of entries in the sidebar tree

settings.label: Sidebar Folders First
settings.description: Keep folders above files in the sidebar tree; off sorts folders and files together

settings.label: Auto-reveal current file
settings.description: Keep the active note highlighted in the file tree: expand its folders and scroll to it when you switch notes.

settings.label: Sidebar Search Button
settings.description: Show the Search button at the top of the sidebar

settings.label: Sidebar Recents
settings.description: Show the Recents section in the sidebar

settings.label: UI font
settings.description: Font family and fallback stack used throughout the app
settings.default: "SF Pro", -apple-system-body, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, "Apple Color Emoji", Arial, sans-serif, "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol"

settings.label: Editor font
settings.description: Font family and fallback stack used for document text
settings.default: "SF Pro", -apple-system-body, ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", Helvetica, "Apple Color Emoji", Arial, sans-serif, "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol"

settings.label: Code font
settings.description: Font family and fallback stack used for code
settings.default: "SF Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

settings.label: Preset
settings.description: Light theme preset
settings.$comment: Valid values are populated at runtime from shared/themes/*.json plus the special "custom" sentinel; we intentionally don't enum-constrain the contract so adding a preset doesn't require a schema edit.

settings.label: Accent
settings.description: Light theme accent color

settings.label: Background
settings.description: Light theme background color

settings.label: Foreground
settings.description: Light theme foreground color

settings.label: Translucent
settings.description: Light theme translucency (0 = solid, 100 = max).

settings.label: Contrast
settings.description: alpha multiplier on borders, cards, hover bgs.

settings.label: Preset
settings.description: Dark theme preset
settings.$comment: Valid values are populated at runtime from shared/themes/*.json plus the special "custom" sentinel; we intentionally don't enum-constrain the contract so adding a preset doesn't require a schema edit.

settings.label: Accent
settings.description: Dark theme accent color

settings.label: Background
settings.description: Dark theme background color

settings.label: Foreground
settings.description: Dark theme foreground color

settings.label: Translucent
settings.description: Dark theme translucency (0 = solid, 100 = max).

settings.label: Contrast
settings.description: alpha multiplier on borders, cards, hover bgs.

settings.label: File Associations
settings.description: File patterns to include in the workspace

settings.label: Default Encoding
settings.description: Default text encoding for files

settings.label: Insert Final Newline
settings.description: Ensure files end with a newline when saving

settings.label: Trim Trailing Whitespace
settings.description: Remove trailing whitespace from lines when saving

settings.label: Restore Open Files
settings.description: Reopen previously open files when opening a workspace

settings.label: Max Recent Workspaces
settings.description: Maximum number of recent workspaces to remember

settings.label: Wrap Lines in Code Files
settings.description: Wrap long lines in the code editor (code and text files such as .py, .ts or .json). Off keeps one line per row and scrolls sideways.

settings.label: Code and Text File Extensions
settings.description: Extensions (without the dot) of code and text files shown in the sidebar, quick open and search, and opened in the code editor. Dockerfile and Makefile are recognised by name. Secrets (.env, keys, files named like credentials), .svg and .ipynb are never listed. Binary files and files over 20 MiB never open as text.

settings.label: Ignored Folders
settings.description: Folder names kept out of the sidebar, quick open, search and the index at any depth (bulky or generated trees). A vault .gitignore is also respected. Hidden folders (.obsidian, .git, .chats, .writer) stay hidden. Takes effect for the index the next time the workspace opens.

settings.label: Show Agent Skill Folders
settings.description: Show .agents/skills and .claude/skills (agent skills with their scripts) in the sidebar and index. Nothing else inside .agents or .claude is shown, and .claude/settings*.json never is. Takes effect for the index the next time the workspace opens.

settings.label: Install Agent Skills
settings.description: Keep Writer's agent skills (writer-cli, writer-search, writer-bases) in .agents/skills and .claude/skills of every workspace you open, so Claude Code and other agents know how to use the writer command. Writer overwrites those skill files when it updates them and never touches skills it did not write. Commit them with your notes if you want to share them.

settings.label: Default Terminal
settings.description: Terminal application name on macOS, or executable name/full path on Windows and Linux. Leave blank for Writer's platform default; arguments are not supported.

settings.label: Restore Workspace
settings.description: Automatically reopen the last workspace when the app starts

settings.label: Search Debounce
settings.description: Delay in milliseconds before performing search

settings.label: Max Search Results
settings.description: Maximum number of search results to return

settings.label: Share Usage Data
settings.description: Send usage events (app opened, workspace opened, file and folder created) to help decide what to build next. Off until you turn it on. Never includes your documents, file names, or paths; the full list is in the Telemetry doc in Writer's repository.

settings.label: Email
settings.description: Optional. Give the maintainer a way to tell you about new releases and ask about the features you use. Sent on its own when you change it, whether or not Share Usage Data is on; clear it to remove the address and go back to being anonymous.

settings.label: Log level
settings.description: How much Writer writes to its local log files. Info (default) records everything notable, including plugin loads and file deletes; debug adds more detail and grows the files faster; warn and error record less. The WRITER_LOG environment variable overrides this. Logs stay on this computer.

settings.label: Check for plugin updates automatically
settings.description: Look for newer versions of your installed community plugins shortly after Writer starts and every few hours while it is open. Updates are never installed on their own.

settings.label: Claude binary
settings.description: Absolute path of the claude CLI to run. Leave blank to find it automatically (PATH, your login shell's PATH, common install folders).

settings.label: Model
settings.description: Model alias or full name passed as --model (letters, digits and . _ : [ ] / - only). Leave blank for the CLI's default. The chat's own menu can change it per chat.

settings.label: Effort
settings.description: Reasoning effort passed as --effort. Default leaves it to the CLI.

settings.label: Models in the model picker
settings.description: Which models the agent composer offers. Switched on and off in Settings > Agent; the first entry (default) cannot be removed. Entries are model aliases or full names passed as --model.

settings.label: Permission mode
settings.description: What the agent may do without asking. manual asks before edits and commands (labelled Ask before edit in the pane), acceptEdits auto-edits files in the project, plan only plans, auto and dontAsk ask less. bypassPermissions is never offered.

settings.label: Always-allowed tools
settings.description: Permission rules passed as --allowedTools, one per entry, in Claude Code's rule syntax, for example Bash(git status). The defaults allow only read-only `writer` commands (search, backlinks, links, properties, bases); reads inside the vault already need no rule. Rules you chose with Always allow are stored by the CLI in the folder's .claude/settings.local.json and listed below.

settings.label: Never-allowed tools
settings.description: Permission rules passed as --disallowedTools, one per entry, for example Bash(rm:*).

settings.label: Attach the open note
settings.description: Attach the note open in the editor to each message by default (as a path; the agent reads it itself). You can remove the chip per message.

settings.label: Share open tabs
settings.description: Tell the agent which notes and files are open in your editor tabs (paths, tags and link properties only, never note text), once and again whenever they change. Turn off to share only the attached note.

settings.label: Inject AGENTS.md
settings.description: How a project's AGENTS.md reaches the agent. auto adds it only when Claude Code would ignore it (a CLAUDE.md sits next to it, or the CLI is older than 2.1.325); always always adds it; never relies on the CLI alone.

settings.label: Show changes after each turn
settings.description: When a turn ends and the agent changed files in your vault, show a Changes card with a diff per file and an Undo. Writer keeps a copy of each edited file from before the turn in memory only (never on disk, never logged) so it can show the diff and undo it; the copy is dropped when the app quits. Changes made by shell commands are not tracked.

settings.label: Chats running at once
settings.description: How many agent processes may run at the same time in a window. Extra chats wait until one finishes; an idle chat's process is stopped after 30 minutes and resumed on the next message.

settings.label: Keep chat history for (days)
settings.description: Chat notes older than this many days are offered for clean-up in the history view. 0 keeps them forever. Nothing is deleted automatically.

settings.label: Name chats automatically
settings.description: After the second reply (or the first, when your first message is long), ask the cheapest model for a short title and rename the chat with it. The first messages are sent to the same provider the agent already uses. A title you set yourself is never replaced.

settings.label: Chat title model
settings.description: Model alias or full name for automatic chat titles (letters, digits and . _ : [ ] / - only). Leave blank, or write auto, for the cheapest model (haiku); if it is unavailable the chat's own model is used.

settings.label: Orchestrate with sub-agents
settings.description: Tell the agent to split work into parts and run cheap sub-agents in parallel (the read-only writer-explorer) for exploring, searching and summarising, doing only very simple work itself. Adds a short paragraph to the Writer system block and defines the sub-agents with --agents. Their tool calls use the same permission prompts and allow rules. Turn off to chat with a single agent.

settings.label: Sub-agent model
settings.description: Model alias or full name for the writer-explorer sub-agent (letters, digits and . _ : [ ] / - only). Leave blank, or write auto, for the cheapest model (haiku). Used only when Orchestrate with sub-agents is on.

settings.label: Restore open chats
settings.description: Bring back the chats that were open in the agent pane, with the same active chat, when you reopen the vault. Transcripts come from the saved chat notes; nothing runs until you send a message.

settings.label: Agent pane width
settings.description: Width of the agent pane in pixels. Dragging the pane edge changes it too.

settings.label: Agent pane open
settings.description: Whether the agent pane is open. Opening or closing the pane changes it, so the pane comes back the way you left it when you relaunch Writer. Restoring it open never starts the agent.

settings.label: Tables
settings.description: Turns the Tables feature on or off.

settings.label: Mouse buttons
settings.description: Turns the Mouse buttons feature on or off. The Rust part takes effect after a restart.
